notes: DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #1 — gated affordance visibility. Day 1 EM Bedroom shows 4 in-narrative options: Study, ❌ Too early to sleep ❌, Nap, Wardrobe. The Sleep option is RENDERED with ❌ markers around its label even though it's gated by time-of-day. Player sees the option exists right from Day 1 — discovery is by SEEING NOT FIRING. Doesn't need to click and fail to learn Sleep exists.

DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #2 — META-DISCOVERY SURFACE = WALKTHROUGH SCENE TABLE. Every NPC + every Location is pre-declared on the Walkthrough page from Day 1. Click an NPC name → drill into a scene table with columns: SCENE / NPC / REQUIREMENTS (NPC) / REQUIREMENTS (MC) / CHANCE / GUIDE / STATUS. The GUIDE column is concrete prose ('Take the test and get at least an 8 grade', 'Have at least 15 relationship points with Marcus, wait for his invite and go to the date with him'). REQUIREMENTS columns are numeric (Corruption: 30) or None. CHANCE is % (100=deterministic, <100=random encounter). STATUS shows 🔒 Locked / 🔓 Unlocked. PLAYER KNOWS ALL CONTENT EXISTS FROM DAY 1 — discovery isn't about IF something exists, it's about HOW to unlock. This is RTS's answer to 'appears from nowhere': activities still pop into the room buttons when prereqs clear, but the player who reads the walkthrough already knew about them.

DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #3 — POLITE-DECLINE NOTIFY-FAIL. Cheats panel itself is a notify-fail example: clicking it shows 'Cheats are only for Patreons / Become a Patreon / Return'. Player learns WHY (patreon-only) and gets an UPGRADE PATH (Become a Patreon link), not a silent no-op. This is RTS's pattern for hard-gates: tell the player the threshold + offer the way.

DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #4 — NPC ABSENCE = EXPLAINED EMPTY. Visiting BrotherBedroom when Stepbrother is at school shows: 'Your Stepbrother is at school' + Hallway-return. Empty room is NEVER silently empty. Player learns NPC has a schedule + WHERE he is right now. RTS doesn't make players guess why nothing's happening.

DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #5 — SAME-BUTTON-ESCALATION IS HIDDEN. Living Room 'Play videogames 🎮' at corruption 0 fires a UTILITY ONE-LINER: 'You are playing a game on the console, you are very focused on the game.' Walkthrough lists 'Playing Videogame' as a Stepbrother scene at Arousal 🔥🔥 + Corruption 10 + 20% chance, GUIDE: 'Play videogame at your living room'. The button label DOES NOT CHANGE between tiers. Player's only signal that escalation exists = walkthrough table. The button is the SAME affordance at every stat tier; what fires varies. Discovery is via meta-surface (walkthrough), not in-button cues.

DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #6 — TOAST NOTIFY-FAIL CONFIRMED. Clicking School in Residential while wearing Default Casual outfit produces a transient TOAST at top of screen ('You need to wear school clothes to go there!' per prior session catalog) without changing the passage. Player learns the gate-reason without a hard interruption (no modal, no passage change). Toast is short-lived. Same pattern from sidebar 'Go to School' shortcut. Combined with Cheats panel (polite-decline) + room-button ❌ labeling (visible disabled), RTS uses THREE notify-fail tiers: (1) ❌ visible-disabled label = soft-known-blocked, (2) transient TOAST = clicked-and-learned, (3) modal page (Cheats) = fundamental gate with upgrade path.
